context_requirements: Active transcription and proliferation (RNAP II dependence)
Intact apoptotic machinery for late cell death
TP53 status modulates the late arm (wild-type lines favor CDKN1A/GADD45 induction)
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation-associated landmark transcripts (e.g., MYC, CCNA2, CCNB1) at 24 h in any line
No induction of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h
Responses indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines
Selective strong response in only one line with no dose- or time-dependence

evidence.supports: 3'-ethynylcytidine, an RNA polymerase inhibitor, inhibits transcription and sensitizes tumor cells, supporting antiproliferative transcriptional consequences in human cancer lines
RNAP inhibitors block nucleotide addition, establishing direct inhibition of transcription as the mechanism
RNAP switch-region inhibitors block transcriptional initiation, supporting rapid loss of RNA synthesis
